decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a niche, long-cycle specialist market where uncertainty about value persists and carrying costs are low, so the option is worth holding.
The desk lamp has its own page, which signals a commitment, and it fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio, so it is cheap to keep while demand is still uncertain.
This second-generation core interior luminaire is actively promoted and supports the established business, so dropping it is unlikely.
The microprismatic pendant only gets a mention and competes with many similar options in a crowded office-lighting range, but one year is too early for its value to have resolved.
HMI searchlight technology is becoming outdated as the firm shifts to LED, which raises the drop risk, but marine customers need long support cycles and carrying costs are low.
This marine searchlight serves the specialist robust-lighting niche at low carrying cost, so the option is still worth holding.
